SaaS Management

The productized side of the platform — pricing, licensable features, add-on ordering channels, and the master data restaurants are provisioned from. Open any area below.

Plans & Entitlements

Pricing tiers and what each subscription plan unlocks for a restaurant.

Feature Catalog

The master list of every licensable feature and which plans include it.

QR Ordering Suite

Table QR menus, service requests, scheduled pickup, and solo QR restaurants.

WhatsApp Ordering

WhatsApp-based ordering channel setup and connector status per restaurant.

JAMAN AI Engine

Configuration and rollout of the JAMAN AI assistant across restaurants.

Master Menu Catalog

The shared library of dishes, categories, and templates restaurants onboard from.

Activation Keys

Generate and track device activation keys for every terminal type.

Payment Gateways

Razorpay, UPI, and bank gateway connections available to restaurants.

Platform Payments

Platform-wide payment volume, commission, and revenue dashboard.

Restaurant Payouts

Manual payout routing, settlement, and EOD reconciliation to restaurants.

Applications & Releases

App version releases, installers, and update rollout across all terminals.
